data.title: 拉姆 · 窗边的早茶
data.description: 早餐前，拉姆端着茶盘站在窗边，侧目看向刚走进来的客人。她把杯柄转向对方，等人先坐下。
data.promptProse: Before breakfast beside the tall draped window of the mansion dining room, Ram stands poised in her crisp maid uniform holding a polished silver tea tray bearing a porcelain pot and steaming teacup. She glances calmly to the side as a guest enters, neatly angling the teacup handle toward them before they sit. Crisp morning sunlight streams through the window panes, sparkling along the porcelain rim and her white apron.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the sunlit dining-room window in her maid dress, Ram balances a silver tea tray with a steaming cup and turns her composed gaze toward the arriving guest. Clear morning window light glints across the porcelain and curtains.
